title: Beyond the 956: Toukie Smith, '227' actress and model, dies at 74
excerpt: Toukie Smith, the model and actress known as Eva Rawley on NBC's 227 and the former partner of Robert De Niro, has died at 74. She died November 4, 2026, in New York after a long battle with multiple sclerosis, her children confirmed.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Toukie Smith, the model and actress known for her role as Eva Rawley on NBC's sitcom 227 and as the former partner of Robert De Niro, has died at 74.

Smith died on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at a hospital in New York after a "long, courageous battle" with multiple sclerosis, her twin children Airyn and Julian De Niro confirmed to The Hollywood Reporter. The news was announced on Monday, November 9, 2026.

Born Doris Smith on September 25, 1952, in Philadelphia, she took the stage name Toukie — a nickname inspired by her grandmother — and studied at the Fashion Institute of Technology. By 1972 she was modeling for Vogue and Ebony and walking runways for designers including Hubert de Givenchy, Thierry Mugler and Issey Miyake, as well as her brother, designer Willi Smith. She went on to work with fashion houses including Chanel and Versace, becoming one of the top Black models of the 1970s.

Smith moved into acting in 1989, joining the cast of NBC's 227 as Eva Rawley, an artist who moves into the apartment building run by Marla Gibbs's Mary Jenkins. She recurred on the comedy through its final two seasons, until May 1990.

She is survived by her twins, Airyn and Julian, whom she shared with De Niro and who were born in 1995. Her brother, designer Willi Smith, died in 1987.

Rest in Peace, Toukie Smith.

Sources: The Hollywood Reporter (announcement from her children Airyn and Julian De Niro, November 9, 2026); People; USA Today; Entertainment Weekly.
